ui.release-notes.v205-new-restart: When an update finishes downloading, Restart to update appears next to Settings and at the bottom of the settings nav — one click installs.
ui.release-notes.v205-new-whats-new: After an update restart, a What’s new panel summarizes this release; you can turn off auto-show and re-enable it in Settings.
ui.release-notes.v205-new-character-pack: Character pack Scheme A/B tooling for pack authors (official app stays single-character Nomi).
ui.release-notes.v205-improvements-insta: Smaller installers: drop duplicate asarUnpack binaries, ship only current-platform native prebuilds, and trim unused packaging weight.
ui.release-notes.v205-fixes-providers: Custom-provider test-model field and cancel-add-provider detect race.
ui.release-notes.v205-fixes-sidebar-rena: Renaming from the collapsed sidebar expands first so the inline editor is visible.
ui.release-notes.v205-fixes-privacy-log: Privacy-log clear no longer races with in-flight async writes.
ui.release-notes.v205-fixes-windows-writ: Windows: more private-file writes use async atomic saves (quit still waits for pending work).
